# central-logs

> Self-hosted, single-node centralized logging platform. One Rust binary.
> One DuckDB file. One WAL directory. HTTP/JSON + OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP
> + syslog + Sentry-SDK ingest. Dashboards, forecasting, anomaly
> detection, error-group tracking, and a 5-tool MCP server for AI agents.

This file is a discoverable index for LLM agents. The full prose is at
the same host under `/` (Read the Docs renders the rest of the docs).

## Capabilities

- **Ingest**: NDJSON / JSON over `POST /v1/logs`; OTLP/HTTP on
  `/v1/traces`, `/v1/logs`, `/v1/metrics` (protobuf + JSON); syslog UDP
  + TCP on `:5140`; Sentry-SDK ingest on `/api/{project}/envelope/`
  and `/api/{project}/store/`.
- **Store**: DuckDB hot tier + hive-partitioned Parquet cold tier,
  per-service retention.
- **Query**: a safe filter DSL (`service:api level:error user_id:42`).
- **Dashboards**: volume, error-rate, latency p50/p95/p99, anomalies,
  forecast overlay. SPA + JSON API.
- **Error tracking**: Sentry-compatible ingest, fingerprint grouping,
  Errors SPA page, AI explain.
- **Alerts**: filter DSL + threshold / anomaly / count /
  error-group-threshold conditions; email / Telegram / webhook channels.
- **AI features**: 5 MCP tools + an LLM-backed natural-language → filter
  DSL endpoint (OpenAI / Anthropic / 9inference).
- **Housekeeping**: backups to local + S3/GCS, restore, retention,
  pipeline health metrics, Prometheus `/metrics`.

## How agents should connect

- **MCP (preferred)**: `central-logs --mcp-mode stdio`. Tools:
  `query_logs`, `get_dashboard_summary`, `detect_anomalies`, `forecast`,
  `create_alert_rule`. `create_alert_rule` is gated behind
  `--enable-alert-mcp-tool`; every rule it creates lands in
  `pending_approval` and needs a human to approve before firing.
- **HTTP**: every endpoint is JSON + bearer auth (`clk_...` API keys
  scoped to `insert` / `read` / `write` / `admin`).

## Record shape

Every inserted record carries:

```
{
  "service":   "<primary filter key>",
  "level":     "info" | "warn" | "error" | "debug" | "fatal",
  "msg":       "<free text>",
  "ts":        "< RFC3339 or unix seconds, optional>",
  "trace_id":  "<correlation, optional>",
  "duration_ms": <number, feeds latency dashboards, optional>,
  ...          <everything else becomes queryable attributes>
}
```

## Safety

- Filter DSL compiles to parameterized statements; unknown columns are
  rejected at parse time.
- Alert rules created via MCP always need human approval.
- Per-service query caps prevent one wide scan from squeezing the node.
- WAL cap refuses inserts (503) before disk fills.

## What it does not do

- No cluster / multi-node (one binary per box).
- No separate database server (DuckDB is embedded).
- OTLP/gRPC (port 4317) is not implemented — use OTLP/HTTP.
- Remote MCP transport (SSE / streamable-HTTP) is not implemented —
  stdio only in this version. `mcp_mode = sse` is rejected at startup.

## Auth model

- Static admin: `CENTRAL_LOGS_HTTP_API_KEY` env var (recommended).
- CRUD keys via `POST /v1/api-keys` (admin required). Raw value shown
  once, stored as SHA-256 hash.
- Browser sessions via `POST /api/auth/login` → `cl_session` cookie.
